name: Hu tieu mi hoanh thanh
summary: A breakfast bowl that brings hủ tiếu, mì, and hoành thánh wontons together, served on Ngô Thời Nhiệm by a Hoa family shop nearly 50 years old.
where: Ngô Thời Nhiệm, in the center.
seoTitle: Hu tieu mi hoanh thanh — a Quy Nhon breakfast
seoDescription: Hủ tiếu mì hoành thánh is a Quy Nhon breakfast bowl of noodles and wontons from a Hoa family shop on Ngô Thời Nhiệm.
